name: planegcs
status_note: This one IS proven, and it is the only one: planegcs is vendored in-tree at forge-kernel/3rdParty/planegcs and compiled directly into forge_kernel by forge-kernel/CMakeLists.txt. There is no acquire step to execute, and `tools/deps/forge_deps.py verify` checks both its content fingerprint and the include-layer patch contract on every run.

acquire.note: Vendored verbatim except for the include-layer edits recorded in third_party/patches/planegcs/0001-standalone-includes.md.

features.eigen: NONE. planegcs upstream expects Eigen; Forge compiles it against the in-house drop-in shim forge-kernel/3rdParty/planegcs_eigen_shim, backed by forge::native::linalg. There is no Eigen package in the dependency plane and no find_package(Eigen3) anywhere in the build.
features.boost: Boost.Graph + Boost.Math headers only, from the boost port.

configure.reason: compiled as part of forge_kernel, not as a separate library

smoke_test.description: The patch contract is machine-checked, not just documented.
smoke_test.expect: no PATCH DRIFT finding for planegcs

known_gaps: No byte-exact diff against upstream FreeCAD exists, because the upstream tree is not in the local mirror. The patch is recorded as an enforced content contract instead — see the patch file for exactly what that does and does not prove.
